text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer.
I'm going to do a light warm-up lap before training.

Even on New Year's, Silence Suzuka remains completely indifferent.
Seeing her usual self makes me want to start a conversation that feels a bit more like New Year's.
choice_data_list: ...Have you decided on a new resolution?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"New resolutions"...?
Umm... I just want to run a whole lot.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Umm... feeling the air,
without being bound by anything...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I want to run in lots of free races like that.

After confirming her passion for racing,
I make a proposal.
It was something I'd been thinking about since the end of the year.
choice_data_list: How about aiming for the Classics this year?
Want to aim for the Classics this year?

text_block_list.text:
The overwhelming speed she showed in her "Debut Race."
It won't be easy, but it shouldn't just be a pipe dream either.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: A Classic race, is it...!
choice_data_list: An unbelievable view surely awaits us.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...What an incredible... sight...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, we will definitely run in the Classics.
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm going to go run for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...If there is anything else I need to do
to prepare for the Classics, I can do that instead."
choice_data_list: First of all, Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Speed, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Indeed... only chosen Umamusume get to run in the Classic races."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"You can't aim for the lead with half-baked speed,
...right?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I want to pursue speed.

And so, we worked on form that day,
getting in plenty of speed training.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Relaxation, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, well then...
I think I'll go for a walk.
Er, the air outside is quite nice today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, see you later, then.
At training.

Perhaps because she was fully relaxed,
that day's training began in an unusually laid-back atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...!
I completely forgot...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
I look forward to working with you again this year.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, so that's why you asked about my aspirations.

Afterward, now that she remembered New Year's,
we decided to go on our first shrine visit of the year for now.
